## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION: Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive (only Technology). Confirmations: extremely weak sector breadth and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5: 4/5 Tech), while Financials and defensives are not leading.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials, Industrials and Financials lag: PPG (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -12.50%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — Growth/Momentum style (narrow).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND; DD (1W: -8.86% | 1M: -0.57%) BELOW TREND; AMAT (1W: -8.93% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION; F (1W: -8.96% | 1M: -10.19%) BELOW TREND; NEM (1W: -8.96% | 1M: +7.99%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Materials/Industrials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND; notable divergence: INTU shows bearish news (-55) while price is ABOVE TREND — distribution signal to monitor.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leading narrowly: Technology (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +2.97% | 24 stocks) with pockets of strength — MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) BELOW TREND; sector breadth is the lone positive sector (1/11).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials soft: Financials (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -6.74% | 20 stocks) with BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND — breadth and leadership weak.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows mixed signals but overall soft: Healthcare (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +0.33% | 17 stocks) with JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -2.56% | 1M: +7.01%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to high-conviction tech winners (INTU, SHOP, NOW) while reducing exposure to broadly weak Financials and Materials; monitor distribution signals where bullish price action conflicts with bearish news (e.g., INTU).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TGT (1W: +6.16% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed; JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION — watch follow-through on trial news. BEARISH: BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed; INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND — news (-55) divergence to watch.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (only positive sector; breadth: 1/11 sectors positive). BEARISH: Financials, Materials, Industrials (all showing 1W weakness; monitor breadth deterioration).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA 700 resistance (NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND) — watch breakout continuation; AAPL 150 support (AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) BELOW TREND) — failure risks further downside; BLK 800 level (BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND) — breach would signal deeper Financials stress.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
TGT (+55): TGT (1W: +6.16% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming. JNJ (+55): JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION — positive trial data but short-term pullback (divergence). WMT (+50): WMT (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -2.05%) BELOW TREND — bullish headline vs falling price (divergence, watch).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (-55): INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND — price contradicts bearish headlines (major divergence). BLK (-50): BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND — news and price aligned. CVX (-45): CVX (1W: -0.08% | 1M: +6.73%) CORRECTION — bearish headlines with mixed price signal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with Growth/Momentum style (narrow). INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND and MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: extremely weak breadth (1/11 sectors) and notable news-price divergences (INTU negative headlines vs rising price) — watch for trend break.
